svg.title: High Yellow
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Artsy image explicitly provided by Blanton Museum; independent viewing-room caption also identifies Blanton’s High Yellow (1960). Broad irregular yellow oval on blue upper field; green full-width lower panel. Yellow contour is deliberately asymmetric, not a circle.
